# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Print the appliance ID tag prefilled with the appliance description and appliance number.
3. Complete the form part, which usually includes the complete address of the testing location, the responsible external person, the date of testing, and the name of the testing specialist.
4. In the table section, you can see the following entries:

   | Column | Option | Description |
   | :--- | :--- | :--- |
   | ID Number | F | if the appliance does not pass inspection; also provide the reason for failure in the Defect column |
   | M | if the inspection is suspended pending a defect correction |
   | Z | if there are additional inspection instructions for the appliance |

5. Make sure to note the inspection date.
6. If applicable, provide confirmation signatures from the client and service provider.

Remember that after completing the documentation, you must return the completed inspection form to the testing specialist
